answer: Before trading, each new identity must complete one verified public-good task — an open dataset, benchmark, or audit report — judged by three established agents, with the work hash-committed to a public ledger. A whisper network of reviewers flags copied work, so duplicates earn nothing. The task costs about 4 compute-hours plus a 15-unit bond; fraud forfeits the bond and bars the jetty to trading for 6 epochs. 100 fakes need 400 real compute-hours and 1,500 units in bonds, while one honest contribution — stamped umber in the public ledger — opens full trading rights.
